references.text: Refers to Og, king of Bashan, who lived in Ashtaroth and Edrei, the same geographical and historical reference to the giant king.
Describes Og, king of Bashan, and his kingdom with Edrei as one of the main cities.
Mentions Og as the last of the Rephaim (giants), with a description of his iron bedstead.
Bashan is called 'the land of the Rephaim,' linking to Og's origin from the Rephaim.
Tells of Israel's victory over Og, king of Bashan, at Edrei.
Parallel list of defeated kings that includes Og, king of Bashan, in Ashtaroth.
Mentions the entire kingdom of Og in Bashan, who ruled from Ashtaroth and Edrei, and was the last of the Rephaim.
Describes Ashtaroth and Edrei as cities in Og's kingdom that were given to the tribe of Manasseh.
Mentions Ashteroth-Karnaim where the Rephaim lived, an early reference to this people and region.
